issues.reason: 'State the entity's kind in one ordinary type atom — whether the kind word sits inside the name or beside it' (the Kestrel River exemplar) makes (Member sunken_cove cove) a required atom, and a licensed type atom left out makes two faithful parses differ.

The omission stands — a distributive predicate over a definite plural group 'adds the per-member rule' beside the group event and dropping it is the 'weaker claim' the instruction set names — but the reviewer's bare (Implication (PartOf $x sk_keepers_1) …) would shed the antecedent, and no nesting form for a rule consequent is stated; the licensed composition is a co-premise rule.

The premise is a ground copular atom with no occurrence variable for a whenever Skolem to take, ground Implications are licensed precedent (the Xor exclusivity rules), and a tenseless consequent event is by the status-predicate default the habitual/dispositional reading — so the constant sk_tend_1 is faithful; per-occasion individuation would need a reified state trigger no rule licenses (gap below).

gaps_confirmed: A standing (habitual-present) conditional whose antecedent is a copular state over definite referents: the 'bare when P, Q' rule offers only the whenever machinery (generic/indefinite event trigger) or two ordered one-off events, and neither fits; a per-occasion form would need the state trigger reified as a rule premise.

How a definite plural's per-member distribution rule combines with an enclosing conditional: nesting is specified only for seals; the natural licensed form is the antecedent as a co-premise beside (PartOf $x <group>).
new_gaps: A capitalized plural role-noun label ('the Keepers') whose word transparently names the members' kind: the 'the Wrens' Name-only rule and the definite-plural GroupOf route compete with no tiebreaker.
A season as a bare Time term ('in winter'): only deictic season forms (last_spring) and day-parts are listed as bare constants; the parse's (Time e winter) is an improvisation.

Issue 1: add the member rule conditioned on the antecedent — (Implication (And (Member sk_store_1 large) (PartOf $x sk_keepers_1)) (And (Member (sk_tend $x) tend) (Agent (sk_tend $x) $x) (Patient (sk_tend $x) sk_lanterns_1) (Manner (sk_tend $x) safely) (Time (sk_tend $x) winter))) (STV 1.0 0.9) — beside the group-event rule.
